# KDnuggets

> KDnuggets is a leading resource for data science, machine learning, and AI professionals, covering tools, techniques, and best practices in the field.

KDnuggets provides curated content on AI agents, APIs, and LLM tools with practical guides for developers and data scientists. The site focuses on free and accessible resources for building AI applications with Python and modern frameworks.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- Web Search APIs
- Large Language Models (LLM)
- Python
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- API Integration
- ChatGPT
- Free Tools
- SERP (Search Engine Results Page)
- Firecrawl
- Tavily
- Exa
- LLM Tools
- API Comparison

## AI Agents & LLM Tools

- [7 Free Web Search APIs for AI Agents](https://www.kdnuggets.com/7-free-web-search-apis-for-ai-agents): Guide to 7 free web search APIs for AI agents with Python integration, including Firecrawl, Tavily, and Exa for RAG-ready applications
